  PROBLEM: The changelog says "Merge authorisation keeps its single live head read in `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh`.", but the script makes up to three live `pulls/N` reads before `gh pr merge --auto`. These are line 119 in `reviewed_head_is_current_for_labels`, reached from lines 131 and 178, and line 242, `_ORCH_PR_META_JSON`. The merge calls are at lines 418 and 469.
  WHY: This is a documentation error, not a runtime failure. The changelog now contradicts the corrected `agents.d/9928-review-pr-read-cache.md` fragment, and operators using the changelog to size the #9887 PAT saving would expect one live read. Both reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash also raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

Eviction was added only to `_pr_base_sync_marker_post` in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` (1728-1732, verified). The file is outside files_touched, so this should be tracked as an explicit follow-up.

Line 119 is still a live `gh_retry gh api .../pulls/${PR_NUMBER} --jq '.head.sha // ""'`, reached from 131 and 178, which gives up to three live reads before the merge at 418 and 469. `tests/test_gh_pr_cached_read.py::test_auto_merge_keeps_one_live_head_read_before_merge` allows the in-function reads.
